_comment: Turn-event tracking: read DRAWN_CARD_THIS_TURN — private flag(s) nothing ever set, so the clause could never fire. The canonical keyword functions now record what happened this turn and EVENT_THIS_TURN reads it.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack.
